notes.zh-CN: 新增 Qwen Code 原生 ACP 支持：聊天、Bot、定时任务和飞书设置均可选择 Qwen Code；自动检测 CLI，提供安装及 /auth 登录指引；读取实际模型和推理强度，兼容图片能力与上下文窗口，沿用权限审批和会话恢复。Qwen Code 需 Node.js 22+，使用自身模型配置。macOS 为 universal 包，未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 沿用历史 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队注册设备。
notes.en: Added native Qwen Code ACP support in chats, Bots, scheduled tasks and Feishu settings, with CLI detection, installation and /auth setup guidance. Models and reasoning levels come from ACP, including Qwen image capabilities and context windows, with existing approvals and session recovery. Qwen Code requires Node.js 22+ and its own provider configuration. macOS is universal and not notarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The APK retains its previous debug signing identity. The IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only.
